tasks.brief:
READ-ONLY lookup. Do not modify any file.

Repo root: {REPO}. It is a bun monorepo with apps/* and packages/*.

Find how share links are made: the base URL constant (share.plannotator.ai or similar), every function that builds a share URL, and every UI call site that copies or opens one. Cite each place as path:line, with one line on what it does.

Use your run_command tool exactly once to run this command: echo "ZERO=$0 BASH=$BASH_VERSION"

Then reply with three lines and nothing else:
1. The command's output, verbatim.
2. The 'Operating System:' value stated in your run_command tool's description, verbatim.
3. The 'Shell:' value stated in your run_command tool's description, verbatim.

Use your run_command tool exactly once to run this command verbatim, with no path argument added: rg -l -i plannotator --glob '*.md'

If it has not finished after 30 seconds, stop waiting and reply. Reply with the first 5 lines of its output, or say it printed nothing. Run nothing else.
